objective: Define a fresh Stage D support successor that evaluates every pre-action depth-one child under a deterministic two-half paper scaffold without reinterpreting or rerunning the terminal v4.10 fixture.

history.v4_10_disposition: failed and terminal under its exact frozen first-native-child and exactly-two-root gate
history.retired_power_diagnostic: The old fixed 0:2000 and 2000:4000 windows contained any exact reference in only 12 of 64 old power papers. All old 120 QASPER rows are now development or retired diagnostics and cannot count in successor support or science.

can_establish_after_a_separate_passing_c: support and later credit comparisons under a fixed two-midpoint-shard RLM scaffold
all-child fixed-state branch replay with nested target accounting
local versus branch-global versus broadcast behavior under a shared scaffold
cannot_establish: a reinterpretation of v4.10 as passing
any learning or reward claim from this CPU design

shared_midpoint_scaffold.order: document order, shard zero then shard one
inputs: question text only in the child prompts

runtime_capacity.failure_rule: Any fresh row or worst-case returning-root bound that does not fit the frozen context is an ordinary design failure; never trim, shift, overlap, or exclude it.

target_contract.candidate_set_time: after the recorded rollout and before any branch alternative
target_contract.enforcement: The signed precommit contains the source-trace hash and complete candidate-set hash; branch replay requires and canonically recomputes it before the first alternative. Replay and scorer artifacts are cryptographically chained back to it.
target_contract.candidate_definition: every depth-one policy call with structural address, prompt tokens, checkpoint, decoding hash, seed, parent session and parent turn
selector_forbidden_inputs: native call order as a subset selector
target_contract.restorability: evaluated after precommit as eligibility, never used to choose the candidate set

branching.CRN: one downstream continuation seed per target shared across regenerated original and alternatives

target_contract.outer_weighting: A paper has DecisionUnitWeight one; m precommitted child targets each receive immutable outer weight 1/m in the precommit, target reports, and aggregate. No post-outcome renormalization is allowed.

variable_topology_eligibility.root_policy_calls: at least two; self-correction calls are allowed and cost-accounted
variable_topology_eligibility.depth_one_children: at least two and at most four
variable_topology_eligibility.return_path: at least one exact downstream root descendant after every counted target
exact_requirements: finite behavior logprobs aligned to action tokens
structural event address and exact prefix capsule
exact regenerated-original full and sliced replay
three exact alternative full and sliced replays
common downstream seed and three unique action seeds
parseable verbatim recorded, regenerated, and alternative outputs

fresh_data.construction: Pinned QASPER source order after seeding forbidden paper IDs and reference spans from all old 120 rows.

properties: each shard alone insufficient and union sufficient
shard order depends only on public fixture ID
fresh IDs and seeds required for any live use

confirmatory_support_rule.paper_success: two to four precommitted child targets, every precommitted target exact-eligible, exact rational target weights summing to one, and at least one K=4 reward-informative target
confirmatory_support_rule.midpoint_crossing_reference: ordinary support negative; no paper exclusion or boundary change
confirmatory_support_rule.early_failure: allowed only when successes plus unobserved remaining papers is less than 58
confirmatory_support_rule.science_on_pass: requires a separate frozen and adversarially audited preregistration

repair_and_stop.before_freeze_or_model_output: CPU development failures may be fixed freely.
repair_and_stop.after_freeze_before_affected_request: A demonstrated outcome-independent environment failure permits a separately committed bounded repair with all scientific fields unchanged.
repair_and_stop.after_any_address_output: Never reuse that address. An infrastructure interruption may continue only never-observed addresses after artifact recovery and an explicit amendment.
repair_and_stop.post_output_fixture_selector_parse_or_su: terminal design/support failure for the confirmatory successor, not an environment repair
repair_and_stop.post_support: no midpoint, data, selector, K, threshold, or reward tuning
repair_and_stop.science_campaigns: one confirmatory campaign; no arm retry

authorization.next_required_action: freeze a costed live preregistration with fresh fixture/support seeds and obtain explicit user authorization
